<article title="Shipping times and options">
Standard shipping arrives in three to six business days after the order leaves our warehouse. Express shipping arrives in one to two business days. The estimate shown at checkout counts from the shipping date, not the order date.

We ship to all fifty states and to Canada. Delivery estimates to Canada add two to four business days for customs processing, and duties are collected by the carrier at delivery.

Weather and peak seasons can extend delivery times. If a package is more than five business days past its estimate, contact us and we will trace it with the carrier.

</article>

Customer first name: Amadou
<request>
pick up instead
can i collect my order from your warehouse instead of waiting for delivery? i live nearby.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Amadou,

Thanks for reaching out. Our shipping information covers standard and express delivery options, along with delivery to all fifty states and Canada, but it doesn't mention in-person pickup at our warehouse. Because I can't confirm whether that's available for your order, a member of our support team will follow up with you directly.

In the meantime, our shipping details note that standard delivery takes three to six business days after the order leaves our warehouse, and express takes one to two business days. If a package is more than five business days past its estimate, please contact us and we will trace it with the carrier.

Thank you for your patience.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
